text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That time went straight into prep and follow-ups.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers finally coached from real conversations, not recaps.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Telling them upfront, and offering to pause recording, turned most skeptics into non-issues.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to read the room.

**5. Adoption followed leadership.** Teams whose managers used the notes in pipeline reviews stuck with it.

Verdict: we're expanding the pilot.

What would you want from an AI note-taker?
